[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Info.png[/img] Update of AveryTheKitty and Erins mod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2464923082
[b]The release of RimWorld 1.7 added a system where assets like textures and sounds can be cached to improve performance[/b]. To avoid doubling the size of the mod, it was re-released with only this cache included, you can find the previous version of this mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3670103084]here[/url].

[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [h1]THIS MOD HAS BEEN DISCONTINUED.[/h1] It will not receive further updates. Contact Willow if you have any questions.
Refined Floors adds a selection of new floors to use when building your colony! They're balanced according to other vanilla floors.
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/ReportingIssues.png[/img] [list] [*] See if the error persists if you just have this mod and its requirements active. [*] If not, try adding your other mods until it happens again. [*] Always post your log using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Log Uploader[/url] [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting. [*] Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that. [*] If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the GitHub repository.
